mn2:2.1: 1. A more general translation like 'troubles' is preferable here.
mn2:3.3: para. 3. yoniso—wise and ayoniso—unwise (in the translation ‘coherent’ and ‘incoherent’); for use of the words yoni and ayoni in this sense (i.e. cause or basis) see Sutta 126 (not in this selection), also Comy. to Sutta 12.
mn2:16.2: para. 15. abyāpajjhāparamatāya—for ensuring the minimum of affliction: lit. for the maximum non-affliction.
